topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: So, I've been messaging this person for a while now, and we just figured out we're in the same city. Pretty wild, right? We were sharing some details about our neighborhoods, places we like to hang out, and it just clicked. It's a small world after all. Maybe it's time to take this online chat to the next level and actually meet up, grab a coffee or something. Could be fun to put a face to a name and all that. Wonder what they're like in person.
